title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1 NË QENDËR, RRUGA LIMAN KABA 450,000 €
description_sq:

• Sipërfaqe bruto: 180.33 m²

Për më shumë informacion, na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 IN THE CENTER, LIMAN KABA STREET €450,000
description_en: Modern 2+1 apartment on the 6th floor, located on Liman Kaba Street, in a developed and highly sought-after area of ​​Tirana. • Net area: 147.81 m² • Gross area: 180.33 m² The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with integrated kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a functional corridor. The well-organized floor plan and favorable orientation ensure natural lighting throughout the day. The property is part of a modern complex with high construction standards and offers underground parking, adding daily convenience. Suitable for both comfortable living and long-term investment. It is possible to pay in installments up to 2 years or financing through a bank loan. Parking post available at a price of 35,000 Euros. For more information, contact us.
